name: TPS Eastern Africa (Serena) Ltd
source: TPS Eastern Africa PLC audited financial results for the year ended 31 December 2025, consolidated statement of profit or loss (announcement, pages 1 to 2); absolute KES | CRON 20260930_141849: Operating Expenses FY2024 filled at 3,641,899,000 from the collector's own kenyanstocks.com source row group total Operating Expenses. FY2025 has no such row and is left blank rather than inferred.
note: Revenue is revenue from contracts with customers as printed. Cost of Sales is inventory expensed as printed. Each derived row states its formula; Profit Before Tax, Income Tax, Net Profit and EPS are as printed.
reconciliation_note: Revenue minus Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit, and Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit, on both periods

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.derived_from: Employee benefits plus other operating expenses plus impairment loss plus depreciation, as printed

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derived_from: Profit before depreciation, finance income and costs, results of associates and income tax, less depreciation
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Profit (EBIT) = Gross Profit - Operating Expenses

rows.label: Net Finance Costs
rows.derived_from: Finance costs less finance income, as printed

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Profit Before Tax - Income Tax = Net Profit, and the column ties with it positive

derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
source_note: H1 2026 column from the company filing (https://africanfinancials.com/document/ke-tpse-2026-ir-hy/): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. UNIT CHECK: values whose magnitude did not reconcile with the annual column were withheld (filing unit differed from the statement unit); they were not rescaled. UNIT APPLIED: figures converted x1000 from the unit stated in the filing (e.g. Kshs '000). Conversion only where the result reconciles with the annual column.

periodAlignment.note: this statement and its counterpart cover different periods; pair them by period label, never by array index (see bot/statements.py::pkey)

periodOrder: repaired 2026-10-04: periods were not newest-first; reordered so periods[0] is the newest period and every value stays on its own period label
